verdict.rationale: Reader documents opt-in semantic chunking of its markdown output (`x-markdown-chunking`), which returns an array of chunks instead of one blob, and it accepts Excel files directly. Nothing documents table-aware chunking, and `x-max-tokens` only trims output rather than chunking it. missing for 10: table-specific chunking behavior (e.g. preserving headers or rows across chunks), documented limits for very large tables, hands-on corroboration of chunking on large tabular data.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can extract data from very large tables using intelligent chunking so it fits within processing limits

citations.quote: `x-markdown-chunking` — opt-in semantic chunking of the markdown response. Returns a JSON array (or ``-delimited text) of chunks instead of one blob
PDFs and MS Office documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) can now be POSTed directly via the `file` body field
